parsed.summary: The PR addresses a specific AttributeError but introduces new attributes without proper initialization or context.

issues.description: The PR introduces new attributes '_facecolors2d' and '_edgecolors2d' without proper initialization or context, which may lead to functional incompleteness or unexpected behavior.
The PR does not include any tests to verify the correctness of the introduced attributes or their impact on existing functionality.
The PR introduces new attributes without following the project's conventions for initialization and context, which may affect maintainability and readability.
